subject: S12b touches ReaderPage + ContentRenderer (merged onto your latest): SectionInk wrap, page bar hidden while ink is on, data-block-pm
body:
Rebased onto your ui_copy/shell-slot rework, nothing of yours changed:
- ContentRenderer: each top-level block also carries data-block-pm={ProseMirror position} (@naadi/shared/content/positions, checked against Node.fromJSON on every seeded body). Section ink anchors to it.
- ReaderPage: the ContentRenderer is wrapped in <SectionInk sectionId doc on onToggle offline={fromCache}> (Write toggle + save state + 'section was updated' notice above the text). While ink is on, the page bar (and its phone shell-slot portal) is not rendered: the ink toolbar with its lime 'Ink on' takes its place, so the view keeps one lime action.
- learn.spec offline test: waits for [data-ink-save=saved] before each navigation / going offline (in-flight rule), alongside your data-position-idle wait.
If you rework these spots again, please keep the wrap and the inkOn condition.
